name: Malaysian Chicken Satay Curry
method: braise/curry (sear marinated chicken, simmer 15 min in peanut-coconut satay sauce)
nutrition_basis: published per serving (curry only, no rice); recipe serves 5-6
ingredients: 750g chicken thigh fillets, cut into bite-size pieces
3 makrut lime leaves OR 1 lemongrass stalk
unmapped: makrut lime leaves / lemongrass (flavor infusion; likely no board home)
why: Braised curry - marinated chicken thigh seared then simmered 15 min in a peanut-coconut satay sauce; 40g protein and only 17g carb per serving, calories a safe 600 (curry only, rice excluded). Malaysian cuisine broadens the catalog. Core ingredients all map: chicken-thighs, peanuts, peanut-butter, coconut-milk-canned, soy-sauce, sweet-soy-sauce (kecap manis), curry-powder. Only makrut lime/lemongrass may lack a board home - flagged for the pricer lane.
